title: The Battle of Hogwarts: The Siege

words.text: Many of you mean to fight me. You believe it brave. It is only foolish.
words.speaker: Voldemort

words.text: Bring me Harry Potter, and I will spare every one of you. Refuse, and none of you will see the dawn.
words.speaker: Voldemort

words.text: It only has to hold long enough.
words.speaker: Hermione
